marketReturn.meaning: change in dynasty superflex expert-consensus percentile, not a promised trade return

currentTradeMarketComparator.reason: current evidence only; historical full-universe labels remain unresolved

currentReactionEvidence.reason: current evidence is displayed but cannot affect forecasts without historical counterparts

collegeProduction.license: repository license and upstream ESPN terms apply

athleticTesting.provider: nflverse combine data sourced from Pro Football Reference

gates.label: Full rookie-universe tape
gates.requirement: >= 85% of drafted and identified undrafted rookies, with unranked players retained at the source floor

gates.label: Late-round universe tape
gates.requirement: >= 75% of round-five-or-later and undrafted rookies, including unranked players

gates.label: 180-day out-of-time performance
gates.requirement: beats no-change MAE and draft-capital sleeper basket in both held-out classes

gates.label: 365-day out-of-time performance
gates.requirement: beats no-change MAE and draft-capital sleeper basket in both held-out classes

gates.label: Completed-trade market labels
gates.requirement: historical completed-trade prices including players that reached zero

gates.label: 180-day structured updater lift
gates.requirement: improves base-model MAE without reducing sleeper-basket return in either held-out class

gates.label: 365-day structured updater lift
gates.requirement: improves base-model MAE without reducing sleeper-basket return in either held-out class

gates.label: Historical Sleeper trend tape
gates.requirement: point-in-time add/drop history for held-out rookie classes

v6.3.name: Backtested rookie production and sleeper basket

gates.label: Real NFL rookie production outcomes
gates.requirement: every completed-class prospect has a position-relative rookie PPR outcome, including zero-stat players

gates.label: Historical college identity coverage
gates.requirement: >= 85% of historically market-priced rookies joined by stable ESPN athlete ID

gates.label: Rolling cost-aware sleeper basket lift
gates.requirement: top-eight post-rank-24 basket beats the strongest of market order, NFL draft order, and capital-gap baselines in >= 5 rolling classes with exact one-sided p <= 0.05; sizes 6/8/10/12 must have positive mean lift and majority class wins against both market and draft order

gates.label: Production-feature leakage audit
gates.actual: college seasons <= draft year - 1; combine and NFL draft facts available before rookie-season outcome
gates.requirement: no outcome or post-rookie-season feature enters training
